articles.title: Bitcoin's white paper turns 18, and small businesses are still paying for the bailouts it answered
articles.snippet: Eighteen years after Satoshi published the Bitcoin white paper, business owners are still covering the cost of a system built on bailouts, and they can protect part of their surplus by keeping it in bitcoin, argues Onramp CEO Michael Tanguma.

articles.title: Uber tests how tokenization can put idle cash to work with HSBC, Franklin Templeton
articles.snippet: The pilot let Uber keep funds invested in money market products while accessing cash for payments, even on weekends.

articles.title: Binance uncovers wider breach in $6.3 billion exploit, targets Sunday withdrawal restart
articles.snippet: CEO Richard Teng said hackers erased evidence and bypassed security checks. Binance plans to publish its proof of reserves Monday.

articles.title: Tether’s excess reserves nearly double to $8B as Q3 profit hits $1.5B
articles.snippet: The stablecoin issuer’s US Treasury holdings are comparable to those of major foreign holders, while its Bitcoin reserves were valued at $8.37 billion at the end of September.

articles.title: Hackers Publish Work Details of 41,000 Homeland Security Employees
articles.snippet: A hacktivist group says it took names, titles, and phone numbers of 41,000-plus DHS staff from a login system.
